description: Matched-condition runtime comparison between LinearRaccess and Raccess Window, addressing codex exec's finding that the production Fig. 3/S3.3 'roughly 6-fold' comparison used unequal K (access_len count: 4 vs 1) and unequal timing boundaries (LinearRaccess's Python-side elapsed_sec includes output validation and SHA-256 hashing; Raccess Window's /usr/bin/time -v wraps only the executable). This bundle re-measures both tools with the same K=4 access_len list (1,3,7,10), the same /usr/bin/time -v timing boundary around the executable only, and strictly sequential (no thread pool / no concurrent array tasks) execution.
sampling: 12 log-spaced length bins spanning the full bpRNA-1m(90) filtered dataset (50-4381 nt), up to 34 sequences sampled without replacement per bin (seed 20260919); 408 total.
